parameters.help_en:
The ID of the bastion host instance.
You can call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/153281.html operation to obtain this parameter
parameters.help_zh:
堡垒机实例的ID。
您可以调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/153281.html接口获取该参数
parameters.name: instance_id

parameters.help_en:
The region ID of the bastion host.
For the mapping between region IDs and region names, see https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/40654.html
parameters.help_zh:
堡垒机的区域ID。
区域ID和区域名称的对应关系，请参见https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/40654.html
parameters.name: region_id

parameters.help_en:
The token required for the next query in cursor-based pagination.
Leave this parameter empty for the first query. For subsequent requests, set this parameter to the value of NextToken returned in the previous response
parameters.help_zh:
游标查询下次查询所需的 Token。
首次查询时留空，下次请求时传上次查询返回值中的 NextToken 字段值
parameters.name: next_token

parameters.help_en: The number of entries to return. Default value: 20. Maximum value: 100
parameters.help_zh: 要查询的条数。不填时默认查询 20 条。单次最多查询100条
parameters.name: max_results

parameters.help_en: The project name to query. Fuzzy match is supported
parameters.help_zh: 要查询的项目名称。模糊查询
parameters.name: keyword

parameters.help_en:
The number of entries to skip.
This parameter takes effect only when NextToken is empty
parameters.help_zh:
跳过数量。
仅在NextToken取值为空时生效
parameters.name: skip
